title: Shader Compilation fails with "Unknown identifier in expression" while the variable is defined
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6119) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/499a779b-31bb-42d3-91fb-5a37bf38f568)

The above error messages appear on opening of the editor. Although the material seems fine in the scene, it is not updated in the visual shader preview.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5445bfb5-0231-4c3f-b9c0-ecaace092dad)

The variable `n_out2p0` is defined in the script:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/63da6d85-b903-4f27-9171-4529d8721fda)

### Steps to reproduce

I have no clear idea how it happened; I mainly reopened my project, and might have changed my input node's input to Projection Matrix and then back to Inverse View Matrix. I was trying to make a MPR for another bug when this bug happened !

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-shader-preview.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19108284/test-shader-preview.zip)
